summary: This Innovative Synergy Tech (IST) policy note presents ten everyday tips for promoting respect and allyship among employees, called ISTeers. The tips range from self-education and active listening to pronoun usage, tailored training, and leadership by example. It closes by stressing that IST wants diversity and inclusion to be a living part of its culture, summed up as being "ISTogether".
one_line: Innovative Synergy Tech lists ten practical tips for ISTeers to promote respect, allyship, diversity and inclusion in everyday work.
key_facts: Innovative Synergy Tech (IST) calls its employees "ISTeers".
IST believes a diverse and inclusive workplace is "not just a nice-to-have; it's a must-have".
Tip 1, Start With Self-Education: read books, listen to podcasts and attend webinars, and share an insightful article with a colleague over coffee.
Tip 2, Active Listening Is Key: managers and entry-level employees alike should tune into colleagues' viewpoints and concerns.
Tip 3, Speak Up for Inclusion: amplify great ideas from quiet voices, give credit, and practice "passing the mic".
Tip 4, Celebrate the Calendar: IST's diversity calendar guides events and learning opportunities, from Black History Month to Pride.
Tip 5, Create Spaces for Connection: IST supports employee resource groups where people connect over shared identities or interests, such as virtual meet-ups or lunch-and-learns.
Tip 6, Normalize Pronoun Usage: adding pronouns to email signatures is standard practice at IST.
Tip 7, Mind Your Language: IST encourages language that includes all gender identities, abilities, and cultural backgrounds.
Tip 8, Create Clear Avenues for Feedback: anonymous surveys, suggestion boxes, and open-door policies let ISTeers voice concerns on diversity and inclusion.
Tip 9, Tailor Training to Your Team: IST customizes diversity workshops and programs to its own environment instead of one-size-fits-all training.
Tip 10, Lead by Example: IST leaders set the standard for respect and allyship, since actions speak louder than words.
The conclusion, "We Are ISTogether", says IST is committed to making diversity and inclusion a living part of its culture.
